fields.english:
You have <snort> aided Mangletooth more than I would have dreamed, skyborne.

Thank you.

As long as I remain a captive here, you may bring me blood shards from the Bristleback quilboar and I will bless you with Agamaggan's power.

เจ้าช่วย <พ่นลมทางจมูก> Mangletooth มากเกินกว่าที่ฝันไว้ สกายบอร์น

fields.english: You have learned much, but I sense that there is more left for the spirits to teach you. I can place your foot on the path but cannot guide your steps. Go and find Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar, the next stretch of your journey begins there.

source_record.text: You have learned much, but I sense that there is more left for the spirits to teach you. I can place your foot on the path but cannot guide your steps. Go and find Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar, the next stretch of your journey begins there.

fields.english: Welcome to my forge, Blacksmith. Let me share with you a little secret. No one, no one in the world can you trust. Not men, not women, not beasts ... this you can trust, Steel.
fields.thai: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่เตาหลอมของข้า ช่างตีเหล็ก ให้ข้าบอกเคล็ดลับเล็กน้อยแก่เจ้าเถิด ไม่มีใคร ไม่มีใครในโลกนี้ที่เจ้าไว้ใจได้ ไม่ว่าชาย หญิง หรือสัตว์ร้าย... แต่สิ่งนี้เจ้าไว้ใจได้ เหล็กกล้า

source_record.text: Welcome to my forge, Blacksmith. Let me share with you a little secret. No one, no one in the world can you trust. Not men, not women, not beasts ... this you can trust, Steel.

fields.english: Grom'Gol's safety is my highest priority.
fields.thai: ความปลอดภัยของ Grom'Gol สำคัญที่สุดสำหรับข้า

source_record.text: Grom'Gol's safety is my highest priority.

fields.english:
You've likely heard that Dalaran is suffering from a magical outbreak, and all of our mages are too preoccupied maintaining the city's wards to effectively contain it.

I'd do anything to protect my city, skyborne. Even consorting with the likes of you.
